== Summary ==
[[Matt Sokol]] with [[Team Albany]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Wild Card day, 11 November 1999). Photo: Decipher. Cropped from [[:File:Team Albany DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] (far left, beige cap).

Identification: Decipher's caption names "a Sokol". Bill Bisco (personal communication, 25 October 2026) identified Matt Sokol as the player in the beige cap and yellow shirt. Bill named him in the same cap and shirt in [[:File:DecipherCon 1999 Wild Card hall.jpg]]. Sokol also wears a beige cap in [[:File:Team Albany 2000 Team Championship.jpg]].
